title: ModTheSpire2
description:
ModTheSpire2 is a pre-launch mod selector and restart helper for Slay the Spire 2.

GitHub:
https://github.com/grassdog0/MTS2

Main features:
- Windows launcher with no extra runtime install.
- Choose vanilla, selected mods, load order, and named profiles before the game starts.
- Launcher live view reads Current settings.save order and enabled state, improving compatibility with RitsuLib, Better Mod Menu, and the base game's own mod manager.
- Profile dropdown applies selections immediately. Type a new profile name or select an existing one, then click Save to create/update that profile with current order and enabled mods.
- Vanilla launch now preserves the per-mod list and order for later modded launches.
- Dependency-aware Windows mod list and compatibility with common Workshop manifest layouts.
- In-game ModTheSpire2 Launcher button opens the safe Close and Open Launcher flow for whole-mod changes.
- Close and Open Launcher forwards the current game command line, so renderer flags such as --rendering-driver opengl3 are preserved.
- Steam launch option remains:
"<path to ModTheSpire2Launcher.exe>" -- %command%
- Put extra game arguments after %command%.

Experimental cross-platform preview:
- Added ModTheSpire2Launcher.sh for native Linux / Steam Deck.
- Added ModTheSpire2Launcher.command for native macOS Steam.
- These Linux/macOS launchers are lightweight script-menu previews, not full GUI launchers.
- Linux/macOS support has not been verified on real systems yet. Volunteers and feedback are needed.

Workshop cannot edit Steam launch options automatically. If you want Steam Play to open ModTheSpire2 first, set the launch option manually.
changeNote:
Profile save and compatibility update
- Restored the in-game Mod Settings button to the simpler Close and Open Launcher flow for better compatibility with Better Mod Menu overlays.
- Launcher profile UI now uses one Save button: select an existing profile or type a new profile name, then Save to update/create it.
- The live settings entry is now labeled Current settings.save.
- Vanilla launch preserves the per-mod list and order for later modded launches.
- Includes the previous settings.save exact-id reading fix for mods with overlapping ids/names.
